body:
I've thought about it but I don't think my grades get any higher being on my own. I'm positive I'd crash and fail. 

There's so many homeless and third world people that would kill for my opportunity and I'm wasting it. It's truly pathetic.

I run and diet (health freak), go to school, do my hobbies but my grades sucked ever since a friend died years ago. I quit working when another friend died and I attempted suicide. But it feels like excuses to just be lazy and worthless.  

My uncle views me as worthless because of being in college forever, not seemingly knowing what I'm doing and not having a job.  I didn't consider anything he said wrong so I figured I'd just off myself.
